policies.title: Payroll Exceptions Policy
policies.excerpt: If the account number in the employer payroll file does not match the customer master record, the salary must be suspended. Operations must open ticket OPS-12, attach the mismatch evidence, request employer correction, and notify the customer with a non-sensitive explanation.

policies.title: Payroll Exceptions Policy
policies.excerpt: Customer-facing responses must avoid exposing employer file details. The approved response is: the salary is under operational verification and the bank is coordinating with the employer.

policies.title: KYC Refresh Policy
policies.excerpt: SME profiles flagged for business activity review require updated activity evidence before high-value postings are released.

policies.title: Retail Lending Policy
policies.excerpt: Personal loan pre-eligibility must consider verified monthly income, existing obligations, and debt burden ratio. If verification is missing, the request must be routed for document collection before final approval.

policies.title: Card Operations Policy
policies.excerpt: Temporarily blocked cards may be reactivated only after customer identity verification and fraud-risk check. Customer-facing messages must avoid revealing rule thresholds.

policies.title: Instant Payments Policy
policies.excerpt: CliQ transfers to new or untrusted beneficiaries require step-up confirmation. If customer intent is unclear or risk is elevated, create a service request instead of executing the transfer.

policies.title: Private Banking Secured Facilities Policy
policies.source: Private Banking Secured Facilities Policy - Section 5.1
policies.excerpt: Portfolio-backed credit facilities for VIP clients require collateral valuation, concentration-limit checks, source-of-funds refresh, and Private Banking Credit Committee approval before drawdown.
